rotational-second-law.def: α = τ_net/I: an object’s angular acceleration equals the net torque on it divided by its rotational inertia, and turns the way the net torque does.

massive-pulley.def: A pulley whose rotational inertia matters. The string’s tensions on its two sides differ, and their difference times the radius gives the torque that spins it up: (F_T1 − F_T2)R = Iα.
